Technology stocks were edging higher in recent trading, with shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 adding more than 0.1% while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was climbing nearly 0.5%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) BlackBerry ( BB ) was about 12% higher during Friday trading after the networking equipment and software firm reported better-than-expected fiscal Q2 financial results.
In other sector news:
(+) CaIAmp ( CAMP ) shares climbed moret than 6.8% Friday after the company exceeded Wall Street expectations with its fiscal Q2 results. Adjusted EPS was $0.31 per share during the three months ended August 31, up from a $0.27 per share a year earlier and beating the Capital IQ consensus by $0.03 per share. Revenue rose 7% year-over-year to $96 million, also topping the $95.4 million analyst mean.
(-) Progress Software Corp ( PRGS ) plunged 18% on Friday, falling close to its 52-week low of $34.72 a share, after reporting fiscal Q3 revenue and forecasting below-consensus Q4 financial results. Revenue fell 2% during the three months ended August 31 compared with the same quarter last year to $95.7 million, missing the $97 million Capital IQ consensus. For Q4, the firm is projecting adjusted net income in a range of $0.71 to $0.74 per share on between $107 million to $110 million in revenue. Analysts, on average, are looking for a $0.78 per share non-GAAP Q4 profit on $116.7 million in revenue.
